items.title: 3 Things You Need to Know If You Buy Pfizer Stock Today
items.summary: After a long bout with poor post-pandemic performance, the stock's starting to perk up. The question is, are other investors -- and analysts -- willing to stick their neck out any further anytime soon?

items.title: Is Merck Stock Pricing In A Post-Keytruda Future Too Soon?
items.summary: Merck’s stock is the top performer in its group, but its profitability sits at the very bottom of the pack, forcing a hard question on investors.

items.title: Summit Therapeutics Says It Is Beating Merck With Its Cancer Drug
items.summary: Summit says its ivonescimab is keeping lung-cancer patients alive longer than Keytruda does. The stock is up.

items.title: ABBV Stock Has Returned $62 Billion To Shareholders. Should You Care?
items.summary: A pharma giant delivered substantial cash returns to shareholders while outperforming the broader market. Here is a breakdown of AbbVie's cash-return capacity, and the key commercial metric supporting its durability.

items.title: Pfizer (PFE) Up 12.4% Since Last Earnings Report: Can It Continue?
items.summary: Pfizer (PFE) reported earnings 30 days ago. What's next for the stock? We take a look at earnings estimates for some clues.

items.title: Is Johnson & Johnson Stock Priced For More Growth Than It Has Guided?
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) has had a good year. The stock is up 56.5% over the past twelve months against 19.1% for the S&P 500, and at $271.19 sits at about 99% of its 52-week high. The business is still growing. The risk is that the current stock price discounts an acceleration well ahead of management's near-term guidance.

items.title: Pfizer's Pipeline Strategy Centers on Obesity and Oncology
items.summary: PFE's pipeline is taking center stage as berobenatide and next-generation oncology drugs aim to drive growth from 2028 and beyond.

items.title: Why Did PFE, GTLB, COP Stocks Jump To 52-Week Highs Today?
items.summary: Pfizer, GitLab, and Conoco Phillips shares surged to 52-week highs on Wednesday amid a series of positive company catalysts and optimistic Wall Street coverage.
